summary: PearX S26 is a current Pear VC pre-seed accelerator cohort. Regular applications closed April 12, 2026, but late applications are reviewed on a rolling basis; the cohort starts in July 2026 and runs 12 weeks.

proposed_event.name: PearX S26
proposed_event.description: Pear VC's 12-week pre-seed accelerator with $250K-$2M funding, cloud credits, mentorship, GTM and fundraising support.

dates.date_range_text: S26 applications opened February 10, 2026. Regular deadline was April 12, 2026 at 11:59 PM PST; late applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Cohort kicks off in July 2026 and runs 12 weeks.

sources.title: PearX Application - Pear VC
sources.supports: Official application page states PearX S26 is accepting late applications on a rolling basis after the April 12 regular deadline and lists Pear VC office locations in San Francisco and Menlo Park.

sources.title: Now open: PearX S26 applications - Pear VC
sources.supports: Official Pear VC announcement published February 10, 2026 says applications opened for S26, describes PearX as a 12-week pre-seed program kicking off in July 2026, and states benefits including $250K-$2M funding and over $1M in cloud credits.

sources.title: PearX - Pear VC
sources.supports: Official program page states PearX invests $250K-$2M, provides mentorship, recruiting, GTM, fundraising support, credits, Demo Day, 12-week duration, Summer/Winter cadence, and requires companies to relocate to the SF Bay Area.

notes: No exact July 2026 program start date, program end date, or demo day date was published in the checked official sources, so those fields are null.
Application close is null because Pear VC says late applications are reviewed on a rolling basis after the regular April 12, 2026 deadline, without publishing a final late deadline.
